template.prompt:
From the CONTEXT snippets, extract every normative requirement. Identify obligation (SHALL/WILL/MUST/SHOULD), actor, action, object, conditions, evidence_type. Return JSON lines with keys: req_id, obligation, actor, action, object, conditions, evidence_type, tags, citation.

CONTEXT:
{snippets}

Rules:
- Only extract if an obligation verb is present.
- Prefer clause ids if present; else form req_id from doc_id+page+lines.
- Include one citation in format [Source: doc pX Lx–Ly].

Parse the customer document excerpts and extract explicit requirements the organization must meet. Normalize to the same schema as standards. Mark each with 'customer' tag. Include one citation per requirement.
